Unscheduled items in the window: a named 14A foundry customer (CEO Lip-Bu Tan said a couple are ready to announce in the next two quarters, src 9), Fab 28 restart news (src 10), and semis sector swings (INTC fell 7% on 2026-11-16 with 33 of 34 large semis, src 17). Post-earnings drift after the October 30 guide-down (-28.6%, src 17) and the CEO's $9.7M open-market buy at $64.73 (src 18) pull in opposite directions, so I keep the median at today's $59.66 with a symmetric lognormal of 21% monthly vol, a little below the 86% annual realized / 3.5 = 24.6% because the post-crash spike is fading.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: normalized mid-cycle EPS $1.535 x 23.4x through-cycle (peer median) P/E

inputs_detail.derivation: Normalized-earnings cross-check (playbook 0.2-0.4), rebuilt on stated mid-cycle segment margins from Intel's own recent cycle instead of round-1's blended 12.5% GAAP margin (which mixed in the Mobileye impairment): CCPG 28% (FY2025 28.9%, FY2026 ~27.5%: trough-to-normal client years, src 1-4) on FY2028 revenue 28,073; DCAI 30% (midpoint of FY2025 20.3% trough-recovery and FY2026 38.4% shortage-priced, src 1-4) on 38,500; All other 16% on 4,500; = 20,130; less foundry loss 5,500 (the build's FY2028, not breakeven) and corporate/NCI/SBC/net interest 5,200 (corp_other FY2028) = EBIT 9,430 (mid-cycle operating margin 13.3%); x (1 - 11% company non-GAAP tax) / 5,467M horizon shares = $1.535 x 23.4x peer-median NTM P/E as the through-cycle multiple (no Intel-specific through-cycle P/E history was sourced) = $35.92. Not driver-linked (static per-share value).
inputs_detail.variant_view: Intel's pre-2022 cycle had DCAI margins in the 40s; a 35% DCAI mid-cycle adds ~$0.35 EPS (~+$8 on this leg, +$2 on the target).

downside.story: P10 (~$28.73): PC TAM falls ~15% in 2027 as memory costs bite deeper (vs our -10%), Intel loses client share (RPU -3%), DCAI 10% lower (Fab 28 recovery slips, substrate relief late, AMD's H1-2027 launches and Arm at ~30% of units take share, TrendForce), DCAI margin 4 pts and client margin 2 pts lower, foundry loss $1B wider with no anchor 14A customer, and the market de-rates INTC by 12 turns toward peers as the long-dated share-loss and foundry risks get priced.

base.story: Median: PCs fall ~10% again in 2027 and client margin compresses to 24%; DCAI grows to $34.7B (supply-limited, H2 substrate relief) then $38.5B as AMD/Arm take share, margin 38% then 36%; the foundry loss narrows to $7.0B then $5.5B; EPS on the peers' basis ~$1.36 FY2027 (Zacks $1.31) and ~$1.84 FY2028; INTC keeps what the k-rule keeps of its premium (40.5x on NTM EPS ~$1.80).

upside.story: P90 (~$119.86): PC TAM recovers faster (memory relief in H2 2027), DCAI 10% higher on earlier substrate and Intel 3 capacity, the ~10% price increases hold (+3 pts margin), a named 14A anchor customer with prepayments cuts the foundry loss by $2B, and the multiple holds 12 turns above our base.

reverse_dcf_check: A 40.5x P/E on ~$1.80 NTM EPS implies EPS roughly doubling to ~$3.6 within 3-4 years after the horizon to reach a ~20x peer-like multiple at a flat price: a foundry loss near zero and a ~20% group operating margin by ~2030-31. The share count therefore carries NO SBC dilution (round-1 +1%/yr double-counted it): 5,440M (CFO Q4 guide) growing 0.5%/yr only for Department of Commerce escrowed-share releases.

reasoning: Skeptic lane, round 2. Round-1 errors fixed per the supervisor: (a) shares 5,307M + 1%/yr SBC dilution while SBC was also expensed -> 5,440M (CFO Q4 fully diluted guide) and +0.5%/yr only for escrowed-share releases; (b) the ad hoc -2.6 turn haircut dropped, exit back on the k-rule at refreshed 11-23 prices and Zacks consensus (median 23.4x, own 46.5x, exit 40.5x); (c) tax 15% -> the company's 11% non-GAAP rate, with EBIT moved to the peers' Zacks basis and NCI raised to the CFO's ~$1.1B; (d) the mid-cycle leg rebuilt on stated segment margins (28/30/16%) instead of a blended GAAP margin with the Mobileye impairment; (e) DCAI FY2027 raised from 33.0B (below the 33.2B exit run-rate) to 34.7B for H2 substrate relief. Skeptic evidence I keep: BofA's downgrade to Neutral (weaker PCs with inventory adjustment into 1H27, server supply limits, no major external foundry customer, AMD/Arm competition, 2030 earnings power cut to $5-6), Morgan Stanley's demand for a credible server roadmap, TrendForce (Arm ~30% and AMD rising in 2027, Intel next-gen in limited supply), Fab 28, the class action, NCI and escrow dilution. Against: ~10% CPU price increases (DigiTimes), demand above supply into 2028, net cash $3.9B, the CEO's open-market buy. Result: FY2027 EPS ~$1.36 on the Zacks basis (+4% vs consensus $1.31, inside 5%), FY2028 ~$1.84 (well below the single $3.23 estimate). Research target (12m) $63.55 vs $59.66; P10 $28.73 carries the long-dated share-loss and foundry risks (DCAI -10%, margin -4 pts, -12 turns), P90 $119.86. The research target rose from $53.42 mostly through the corrections (tax, NCI basis, haircut), not a more bullish view. Not driver-linked: the mid-cycle custom leg. Research limited: credit-rating pages found were from 2025 (Fitch BBB, Aug 2025) and not used.

custom.name: Normalized mid-cycle EPS x through-cycle P/E
custom.explanation: Normalized-earnings cross-check (playbook 0.2-0.4), rebuilt on stated mid-cycle segment margins from Intel's own recent cycle instead of round-1's blended 12.5% GAAP margin (which mixed in the Mobileye impairment): CCPG 28% (FY2025 28.9%, FY2026 ~27.5%: trough-to-normal client years, src 1-4) on FY2028 revenue 28,073; DCAI 30% (midpoint of FY2025 20.3% trough-recovery and FY2026 38.4% shortage-priced, src 1-4) on 38,500; All other 16% on 4,500; = 20,130; less foundry loss 5,500 (the build's FY2028, not breakeven) and corporate/NCI/SBC/net interest 5,200 (corp_other FY2028) = EBIT 9,430 (mid-cycle operating margin 13.3%); x (1 - 11% company non-GAAP tax) / 5,467M horizon shares = $1.535 x 23.4x peer-median NTM P/E as the through-cycle multiple (no Intel-specific through-cycle P/E history was sourced) = $35.92. Not driver-linked (static per-share value).

model_inputs.structure_note: Annual driver-led set (7 drivers: PC TAM, client revenue per unit, client margin, DCAI revenue, DCAI margin, foundry loss, corporate incl. NCI, SBC and net interest). Forecast EBIT FY2027-28 is on the peers' Zacks basis (non-GAAP after SBC; impairments, restructuring, amortization and escrowed-share marks out) with the company's 11% non-GAAP tax, so the P/E leg (75%, on the build's own NTM EPS) sits on the same basis as the peer multiples; FY2026 is GAAP actual and does not enter the horizon NTM. Mid-cycle EPS x through-cycle P/E cross-check 25%. No DCF (semis). No FCF-yield leg: forward FCF margin below 2% in FY2026-27 (FCFF -1.0B, -0.2B on the engine rows). No EV legs; minorities enter only through EPS (corp_other).
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) DCAI revenue 34.7B/38.5B sits at the low end of the CFO-endorsed 'mid-30s' and below the booked 37.2B/47.9B; (2) DCAI margin fade to 36% in FY2028 against ~10% price increases; (3) net interest +400/+250 in corp_other rests on an assumed ~3.5% cash yield (low confidence); (4) mid-cycle leg weight 0.25 with the peer median as through-cycle P/E. Engine-sized alternatives on this set: DCAI booked-style 37.2B/47.9B -> $79.2 (+24.6%); DCAI CFO framing 35.5B/41.0B -> $67.73 (+6.6%); DCAI TrendForce-derived 32.6B/36.0B -> $59.15 (-6.9%); DCAI margin held 41.5% -> $73.6 (+15.8%); DCAI margin booked ~39% -> $68.72 (+8.1%); Foundry -7.5B/-6.1B -> $60.64 (-4.6%); No net interest (corp -5,400/-5,450) -> $62.25 (-2.0%); Shares 5,506M flat -> $63.19 (-0.6%). Financing below the 20% bar: a further equity raise by Nov 2027 (~10-15%; cash + ST investments $54.0B at 2026-09-26, F80 + F81, vs FY2027 FCFF ~-$0.2B in this build). Not modeled: Altera 49% and IMS stakes (+$0.5-1/share), DOC warrants (241M shares, only if Intel owns <51% of Foundry, ~10%). Annual set, not quarterly.
